notes: Single-deliverable HTTP-service task: the client manages a local archive server process (free port, start, /health readiness poll, teardown), then walks a two-stage identifier-keyed API — entry metadata first (which deliberately carries no sequences), then one /api/sequence request per listed chain — and must reproduce every returned amino-acid sequence byte-exactly (any edit fails equality against the API). Reasoning_depth=2 (two-stage dependent retrieval keyed off metadata the agent cannot shortcut), adversarial_inputs=2 (chain ids repeat across entries so sequences must be keyed per entry; spec order differs from archive order; a distractor entry exists in the archive but not in the spec). quantitative_correctness=1: total_chains/total_residues must be exact.
